class InternalModelInterface:
    """
    Interface for internal models that wrap generated models via composition.

    This interface defines the contract required for domain-specific internal
    models, enforcing encapsulation of generated API response models and
    delegation of required functionality through explicit adapter methods.
    """

    def to_generated(self):
        """
        Convert the internal model representation back to its generated model
        counterpart.

        :return: An instance of the corresponding generated model class.
        :rtype: object
        """
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement 'to_generated'.")

    def from_generated(cls, generated_instance):
        """
        Factory method to create an internal model from a generated model instance.

        :param generated_instance: A generated model instance.
        :type generated_instance: object
        :return: An instance of the internal model.
        :rtype: cls
        """
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement 'from_generated'.")
